fullContentHtml:
KPCL Result 2026 Out: The Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd. (KPCL) announced the KPCL AE & JE Result on 6th January 2026. This is for the ongoing recruitment through the 2017 cycle.  Candidates who appeared for the KPCL AE and KPCL JE exams can check their results online @kpcl.karnataka.gov.in.  The recruitment is ongoing for 165 Junior Engineers and 278 Assistant Engineer posts. Check the KPCL Result download link, steps to download.  release date, and other details here.

KPCL Result 2026 Out @kpcl.karnataka.gov.in

The Karnataka Power Corporation Limited has announced the KPCL AE Result and KPCL JE Result on its official website. Candidates who took the exam can log in to the applicant portal and check their results online @kpcl.karnataka.gov.in. Check important dates and details below.

Add Testbook as Preferred Source on Google
Add Preference
KPCL Result 2026 for AE & JE Posts
Recruiting Body Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd.
Posts Assistant Engineer, Junior Engineer
Cycle 2017
Exam Dates
  • Written Exam: 18th and 19th February 2024
  • Kannada Exam: 4th February 2025
KPCL Result Release Date 6th January 2026

 KPCL Result Download Link 2026

The KPCL Result for the Assistant Engineer and Junior Engineer posts is available on the official KPCL website. Candidates can log in to the result link using their application number and date of birth. The direct link to download the KPCL AE & JE Result 2026 is given below for your reference.

Direct Link to Download KPCL Result 2026 for AE/JE Posts

How to Download KPCL AE/JE Result 2026?

Candidates can easily download the KPCL Result for the AE and JE posts from the official website. The steps to download the result are explained here for your reference:

Step 1. Go to the KPCL website @kpcl.karnataka.gov.in.

Step 2. Go to the Careers page and click the KPCL AE/JE Result download link.

Step 3. In the login window, enter your application number and date of birth. The KPCL AE Result or KPCL JE Result will appear based on the exam you had appeared for.

Step 4. Check the details mentioned in the KPCL result.

Step 5. Download the result and save it for future reference.

Details Mentioned on the KPCL Result 2026

The KPCL Result PDF contains many important details. Before downloading the results, candidates must carefully check these details to avoid any discrepancies later. The details mentioned in the result include:

  • Name and roll number of the candidate
  • Exam Name/ Post Name
  • Exam date/ cycle
  • Marks obtained by the candidate
  • Qualifying status.

What’s Next After KPCL Result Announcement?

Once the KPCL Result is announced, candidates can check their qualifying status. The shortlisted candidates will be issued their appointment letters in due course of time. Based on the instructions and details given in the letter, candidates can report for joining and related formalities.

We hope these details about the KPCL Result 2026 for AE/JE posts were helpful for you. To prepare for various state and central government exams, download the Testbook App. It has online previous year papers, mock tests, notes, live classes, and more.

FAQs on KPCL Result 2026

Ques. Have the KPCL AE Results and KPCL JE Results been announced?

Ans. Yes, the KPCL Results for AE and JE posts have been announced on the company’s official website.

Ques. When was the KPCL Result for AE/JE announced?

Ans. The KPCL Result 2026 was announced on 6th January 2026.

Ques. How can I check the KPCL AE/JE Result 2026?

Ans. You can check the result from the official KPCL website by logging in to the applicant portal using your application number and date of birth.
